 Original Posting:  

 ​​​​​​The Government is requesting the purchase of security camera maintenance services for barracks located at Fort Rucker, Alabama. This firm-fixed price (FFP) contract is being competed under NAICS code 561621 with a size standard of $25 million and PSC code S211 as lowest price technically acceptable (LPTA) using simplified acquisition procedures (SAP) and is set aside 100% for small businesses with no specified category preference. Quotes from all small business categories are welcome.
